description: Global overview, session explorer and capture health. Click a session to open 'VC QoE: Session detail' (uid vc-qoe-session) for that session's own time range. Generated by make_dashboard_v2.py.

options.content:
**Global view of Zoom, Teams and Meet.** The time range above drives everything on this page: the global panels, the session table and the capture-health row. Rows marked slow are collapsed and only query when opened. **To look into one session:** click any cell of its row in *Session explorer* and choose *Open session detail*. That opens the *VC QoE: Session detail* dashboard in a new tab, already set to the session's own time range. Zooming there changes only that tab, never this page.

**Reading notes.** A session is counted when it has at least one 5 s bin in the range (one that started earlier counts, with its full age). Durations are `session_age_s` at the session's last bin in the range. A gap in a line is not a zero: a field with no value in a bin is not written. Throughput is UDP payload (Zoom: every packet on its gate; Teams/Meet: RTP only).

spec.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "session_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.platform =~ /^${platform:regex}$/ and r.client_ip =~ /.*${client}.*/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field =~ /^(audio_active_s|video_streams_active|screen_streams_active)_(uplink|downlink)$/)
  |> group(columns: ["platform", "session_id", "_field"])
  |> max()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value)}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field =~ /^audio_active_s/ or r._value > 0.0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({platform: r.platform, session_id: r.session_id, _value: 1.0,
        media: if r._field =~ /^audio/ then "Audio" else if r._field =~ /^video/ then "Video" else "Screen share"}))
  |> group(columns: ["platform", "media", "session_id"])
  |> first()
  |> group(columns: ["platform", "media"])
  |> count()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["platform"], columnKey: ["media"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> sort(columns: ["platform"])

spec.description: Sessions in the range that had audio, video or screen share at least once, per platform. A session is counted in each media it had. From audio_active_s_* (audio), video_streams_active_* > 0 (video) and screen_streams_active_* > 0 (screen), so it works for Teams/Meet, which have no session_summary. Heavy: it reads six fields over every bin of every session, so it sits in a collapsed row and only runs when that row is opened (fine for ranges up to about a day).
spec.title: Sessions by media

spec.query:
base = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "session_metrics" and r._field == "session_age_s")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.platform =~ /^${platform:regex}$/ and r.client_ip =~ /.*${client}.*/)

lastAge = base
  |> group(columns: ["platform", "client_ip", "session_id"])
  |> last()

ageS = lastAge
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({platform: r.platform, client_ip: r.client_ip, session_id: r.session_id, _field: "age_s", _value: float(v: r._value)}))

endMs = lastAge
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({platform: r.platform, client_ip: r.client_ip, session_id: r.session_id, _field: "end_ms", _value: float(v: int(v: r._time) / 1000000)}))

union(tables: [ageS, endMs])
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["platform", "client_ip", "session_id"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with
        start_time: time(v: (int(v: r.end_ms) - int(v: r.age_s * 1000.0)) * 1000000),
        end_time: time(v: int(v: r.end_ms) * 1000000),
        duration_min: r.age_s / 60.0,
        start_ms: string(v: int(v: r.end_ms) - int(v: r.age_s * 1000.0)),
        stop_ms: string(v: int(v: r.end_ms) + 5000)}))

spec.description: One row per session. Click any cell, then 'Open session detail': the session dashboard opens in a new tab with the time range set to this session (start to last bin + 5 s). For a session still running the link ends at its last bin so far. Kept light on purpose: it reads only session_age_s with last(), which InfluxDB answers in its storage engine. The audio / video / screen flags and the quality means are in the collapsed row below (open it for ranges up to about a day).
spec.title: Session explorer (sessions in the selected range)

spec.query:
base = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "session_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.platform =~ /^${platform:regex}$/ and r.client_ip =~ /.*${client}.*/)

lastAge = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "session_age_s")
  |> group(columns: ["platform", "client_ip", "session_id"])
  |> last()

ageS = lastAge
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({platform: r.platform, client_ip: r.client_ip, session_id: r.session_id, _field: "age_s", _value: float(v: r._value)}))

endMs = lastAge
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({platform: r.platform, client_ip: r.client_ip, session_id: r.session_id, _field: "end_ms", _value: float(v: int(v: r._time) / 1000000)}))

media = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field =~ /^(audio_active_s|video_streams_active|screen_streams_active)_(uplink|downlink)$/)
  |> group(columns: ["platform", "client_ip", "session_id", "_field"])
  |> max()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value)}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field =~ /^audio_active_s/ or r._value > 0.0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({platform: r.platform, client_ip: r.client_ip, session_id: r.session_id, _value: 1.0,
        _field: if r._field =~ /^audio/ then "audio" else if r._field =~ /^video/ then "video" else "screen"}))
  |> group(columns: ["platform", "client_ip", "session_id", "_field"])
  |> first()

downKbps = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "throughput_downlink_bps")
  |> group(columns: ["platform", "client_ip", "session_id"])
  |> mean()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({platform: r.platform, client_ip: r.client_ip, session_id: r.session_id, _field: "down_kbps", _value: r._value / 1000.0}))

upKbps = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "throughput_uplink_bps")
  |> group(columns: ["platform", "client_ip", "session_id"])
  |> mean()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({platform: r.platform, client_ip: r.client_ip, session_id: r.session_id, _field: "up_kbps", _value: r._value / 1000.0}))

fpsDown = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "fps_downlink")
  |> group(columns: ["platform", "client_ip", "session_id"])
  |> mean()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({platform: r.platform, client_ip: r.client_ip, session_id: r.session_id, _field: "fps_down", _value: r._value}))

jitDown = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "jitter_ms_downlink")
  |> group(columns: ["platform", "client_ip", "session_id"])
  |> mean()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({platform: r.platform, client_ip: r.client_ip, session_id: r.session_id, _field: "jitter_down_ms", _value: r._value}))

degDown = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "degraded_downlink")
  |> group(columns: ["platform", "client_ip", "session_id"])
  |> mean()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({platform: r.platform, client_ip: r.client_ip, session_id: r.session_id, _field: "degraded_pct", _value: r._value * 100.0}))

union(tables: [ageS, endMs, media, downKbps, upKbps, fpsDown, jitDown, degDown])
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["platform", "client_ip", "session_id"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with
        start_time: time(v: (int(v: r.end_ms) - int(v: r.age_s * 1000.0)) * 1000000),
        end_time: time(v: int(v: r.end_ms) * 1000000),
        duration_min: r.age_s / 60.0,
        start_ms: string(v: int(v: r.end_ms) - int(v: r.age_s * 1000.0)),
        stop_ms: string(v: int(v: r.end_ms) + 5000)}))

spec.description: Same table plus the audio / video / screen flags and the mean of throughput (kb/s, up and down), fps_downlink, jitter_ms_downlink and degraded_pct (share of judged downlink bins below 15 fps) over the range. These read every point of five fields, so on a range of days the query can time out: open this row for ranges up to about a day.
spec.title: Session explorer with quality means

spec.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "capture_health")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "dups_dropped" or r._field == "kept" or r._field == "matched")
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> group(columns: ["engine", "_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)

spec.description: kept (Teams/Meet) / matched (Zoom) = unique packets handed to the metrics; dups_dropped = mirror twins. Equal lines = the doubled mirror; dups at 0 = the mirror is fixed (time to use --dedup off).
spec.title: Packets kept and twins dropped per second

spec.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "capture_health")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "dups_dropped" or r._field == "kept" or r._field == "matched")
  |> increase()
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["engine", "_field"])
  |> sum()
  |> group(columns: ["engine"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["engine"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
        k = if exists r.kept then r.kept else if exists r.matched then r.matched else 0
        d = if exists r.dups_dropped then r.dups_dropped else 0
        return {engine: r.engine, _value: if d + k > 0 then 100.0 * float(v: d) / float(v: d + k) else 0.0}
    })

spec.description: Twins dropped / (twins + kept). About 50 % on the doubled campus mirror, about 0 % once it is fixed. increase() survives restarts.
spec.title: De-dup share (range)

spec.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "capture_health")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "capture_disk_bytes")
  |> group(columns: ["engine"])
  |> last()

spec.description: Bytes of ALL capture files (CSV + pcap, three platforms): one shared budget, so both engines show the same number.
spec.title: Capture files: bytes used (shared limit)

spec.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "capture_health")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "capture_limit_tripped")
  |> group(columns: ["engine"])
  |> last()

spec.description: 1 = --capture-max-mb reached: no more capture files are written; metrics continue.
spec.title: Capture limit reached

spec.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "capture_health")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "record_queue_drops" or r._field == "batch_drops" or r._field == "bins_dropped" or r._field == "export_lines_dropped" or r._field == "dump_dropped" or r._field == "pcap_drop_queue" or r._field == "pcap_drop_pool" or r._field == "file_io_errors" or r._field == "zoom_like_unlisted" or r._field == "streams_rejected" or r._field == "rtp_streams_rejected")
  |> increase()
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["engine", "_field"])
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["engine"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

spec.description: Queue drops (record_queue_drops, batch_drops, bins_dropped), export losses, pcap pool/queue drops, file errors, and zoom_like_unlisted (Zoom-looking packets from an address not on ip_lists/zoom.txt: the list is stale).
spec.title: Problems counted in range (all must be 0)

spec.query:
import "array"

found = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "session_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.platform =~ /^${platform:regex}$/ and r.client_ip =~ /.*${client}.*/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "session_age_s")
  |> group(columns: ["platform", "session_id"])
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["platform"])
  |> count()

zeros = array.from(rows: [{platform: "meet", _value: 0}, {platform: "teams", _value: 0}, {platform: "zoom", _value: 0}])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.platform =~ /^${platform:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["platform"])

union(tables: [found, zeros])
  |> group(columns: ["platform"])
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: r.platform}))
  |> group(columns: ["platform", "_field"])

spec.description: Distinct session ids with at least one bin in the selected range, per platform. A platform with no session shows 0. A client that is silent for 120 s starts a new session id, so one person can count twice.
spec.title: Sessions in range

spec.query:
sess = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "session_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.platform =~ /^${platform:regex}$/ and r.client_ip =~ /.*${client}.*/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "session_age_s")
  |> group(columns: ["platform", "session_id"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({platform: r.platform, session_id: r.session_id, _value: r._value / 60.0}))

per = sess
  |> group(columns: ["platform"])
  |> mean()

total = sess
  |> group()
  |> mean()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({platform: "overall", _value: r._value}))

union(tables: [per, total])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: r.platform}))
  |> group(columns: ["platform", "_field"])

spec.description: Mean over sessions of session_age_s at the session's last bin in the range (minutes). 'overall' is the mean over all sessions of the selected platforms, not the mean of the three platform means. A session still running, or cut by the range end, is shown at its age so far. Zoom bins may include a short idle tail, so Zoom can read a few seconds long.
spec.title: Average session duration

spec.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "session_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.platform =~ /^${platform:regex}$/ and r.client_ip =~ /.*${client}.*/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "fps_downlink")
  |> group(columns: ["platform"])
  |> mean()

spec.description: Mean over all bins that had a counted downlink camera stream (fps_downlink = mean over streams of frames / covered s). Absent bins are not counted as 0. Meet and Teams sit near 15 fps on healthy calls and Zoom near 30.
spec.title: Mean downlink fps

spec.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "session_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.platform =~ /^${platform:regex}$/ and r.client_ip =~ /.*${client}.*/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "jitter_ms_downlink")
  |> group(columns: ["platform"])
  |> mean()

spec.description: Frame-level RFC 3550 jitter of the downlink camera stream (ms), mean over bins that have a value.
spec.title: Mean downlink jitter

spec.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "session_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.platform =~ /^${platform:regex}$/ and r.client_ip =~ /.*${client}.*/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "degraded_downlink")
  |> group(columns: ["platform"])
  |> mean()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 100.0}))

spec.description: Share of judged bins (a stream covering >= 4 s, no screen share) whose mean camera fps was below 15.
spec.title: Degraded downlink bins

spec.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "session_metrics" and r._field == "session_age_s")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.platform =~ /^${platform:regex}$/ and r.client_ip =~ /.*${client}.*/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: count, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["platform", "session_id", "_time"])
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: 1.0}))
  |> group(columns: ["platform", "_time"])
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: r.platform}))
  |> group(columns: ["platform", "_field"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

spec.description: Sessions with a point in each window (session_age_s exists in every bin of every platform).
spec.title: Active sessions per platform

spec.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "session_metrics" and r._field == "throughput_downlink_bps")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.platform =~ /^${platform:regex}$/ and r.client_ip =~ /.*${client}.*/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["platform", "session_id", "_time"])
  |> mean()
  |> group(columns: ["platform", "_time"])
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value / 1000.0, _field: r.platform}))
  |> group(columns: ["platform", "_field"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

spec.description: Sum over sessions of throughput_downlink_bps / 1000 (UDP payload). Zoom counts every packet on its gate, Teams/Meet RTP only.
spec.title: Total downlink throughput per platform (kb/s)

spec.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "session_metrics" and r._field == "throughput_uplink_bps")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.platform =~ /^${platform:regex}$/ and r.client_ip =~ /.*${client}.*/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["platform", "session_id", "_time"])
  |> mean()
  |> group(columns: ["platform", "_time"])
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value / 1000.0, _field: r.platform}))
  |> group(columns: ["platform", "_field"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

spec.description: Sum over sessions of throughput_uplink_bps / 1000 (UDP payload).
spec.title: Total uplink throughput per platform (kb/s)
Sessions by media (slow on long ranges: open for up to about a day)
Session explorer with media flags and quality means (slow on long ranges: open for up to about a day)

title: VC QoE: Overview (Zoom + Teams + Meet)

spec.description: Bucket that vc_capture writes to (VC_QOE_INFLUX_URL). Regenerate with --bucket to change it.
spec.label: InfluxDB bucket
spec.name: bucket

spec.description: uid of the 'VC QoE: Session detail' dashboard, used by the table link (/d/<uid>). If the link opens 'not found', set this to the string after /d/ in the session dashboard's URL (Settings > Variables).
spec.label: Session dashboard uid
spec.name: session_dash

spec.description: zoom / teams / meet (tag values in the bucket)
spec.label: Platform
spec.name: platform

spec.description: Only sessions whose client IP contains this text (empty = all). Example: 10.184. selects a subnet.
spec.label: Client IP contains
spec.name: client
